subject: planner: allow correlated exists subqueries to early-out (#63287)
summary: Planner change in `handleExistSubquery`: when `NO_DECORRELATE()` is effective for an `EXISTS` subquery, inject a `LIMIT 1` (unless a `LogicalLimit` already exists) so the inner side of `Apply` can stop after the first match. Adds helper `hasLimit()` for detection; updates expected plan outputs accordingly.
